content: public/ is a build-time route collection, not persisted storage — runtime files are lost on redeploy (Vercel discussion #16417; local dev only). Recommended: store uploads in a private dir (process.cwd()/uploads) and serve via a route handler (app/uploads/[file]/route.ts) reading fs.readFileSync, setting Content-Type + Content-Disposition, guarding path traversal (reject '..', resolve + prefix check), with auth. Small files (<4MB) fine through route handler; serverless FS is read-only so object storage (S3/R2 presigned URLs, sign-upload-finalize pattern with HEAD verification) required only at cloud deploy. Validate: file.type allowlist + magic-byte sniffing (file-type pkg) + size cap; never trust client; DB stores key not public URL; use UUID keys.
